## Checklist

- [ ] `bash scripts/verify.sh push` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] For window, IPC or capability changes: checked by hand with `cargo tauri dev`
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or large binaries
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] AI assistance, if significant, is mentioned above
